evidence_cards.title: Corrected indirect randomized Dato evidence
evidence_cards.text: TROPION-Lung01 was a randomized comparison of Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel after prior NSCLC therapy. Table 2 reports 234 patients per arm in the nonsquamous histology efficacy subgroup, not 229 versus 232. Median PFS was 5.5 versus 3.6 months, HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51-0.79). In the overall population, OS was not significantly improved: HR 0.94 (95% CI 0.78-1.14), p=0.530. Histology subgroups used electronic case-report-form data. These patients do not isolate AVANZAR TROP2-positive disease. Treatment line, combination, comparator and hypothesis differ; neither the PFS signal nor the overall OS null result establishes AVANZAR efficacy.

evidence_cards.title: Indirect first-line combination response evidence
evidence_cards.text: In the small phase Ib TROPION-Lung04 first-line subgroup, Dato-DXd + durvalumab + carboplatin had confirmed-or-pending-confirmation responses in 10/13 patients (76.9%, 95% CI 46.2-95.0). Dato-DXd + durvalumab had 7/14 responses (50%). These are nonrandomized cohorts, response rather than PFS, with no randomized standard-care comparator or isolation of AVANZAR TROP2-positive population. The triplet safety population included 14 patients and must not be given the 13-patient first-line efficacy denominator. This does not establish an AVANZAR effect.

evidence_cards.title: TOPAZ-1 frozen registered design
evidence_cards.text:
Frozen registry NCT04895241: TOPAZ-1; enrollment 548 (ACTUAL); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking QUADRUPLE. Selected primary endpoint: Percentage of Participants Who Achieved a Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Responder Index of 4 (SRI-4) Response at Week 52. Definition: SRI-4 response is a composite endpoint defined by the following criteria:

* Reduction from baseline of ≥4 points in systemic lupus erythematosus disease activity index 2000 (SLEDAI-2K).
* No new organ system affected, as defined by no new organ system with British isles lupus assessment group-2004 (BILAG-2004) grade A and no more than 1 new organ system with BILAG-2004 grade B compared with Baseline.
* No worsening from baseline in lupus disease activity as defined by \<0.3-point increase on 3-point Physician's Global Assessment (PGA) - Visual Analog Scale (VAS).
* No violation to protocol-specified medication rules.. Timeframe: Week 52. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. High-dose group only. Milligram dose not disclosed in retrieved registry; do not guess. Low-dose success or other TOPAZ-named trial does not resolve target.

Frozen registry NCT05774951: CAMBRIA-1; enrollment 4300 (ESTIMATED); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking NONE. Selected primary endpoint: Invasive breast cancer-free survival (IBCFS). Definition: IBCFS is defined as time from randomisation until date of first occurrence of:

* Invasive ipsilateral breast tumour recurrence (invasive IBTR)
* Locoregional invasive breast cancer recurrence
* Distant recurrence
* Invasive contralateral breast cancer
* Death attributable to any cause.. Timeframe: Up to 10 years. There are 1 registered primary-outcome entries. Sponsor year-only 2027 timing; no invented exact date. Post-treatment early recurrence and metastatic PFS are different outcomes.

evidence_cards.title: Negative metastatic PFS prior and distinct positive subgroup setting
evidence_cards.text: SERENA-4 camizestrant + palbociclib versus anastrozole + palbociclib did not meet primary PFS superiority in upfront first-line advanced ER-positive disease. The same announcement notes benefit/approval based on SERENA-6 in emergent ESR1 mutation. Both are advanced-disease contexts and differ from CAMBRIA-1 adjuvant switch monotherapy and invasive breast cancer-free survival.

evidence_cards.text: Frozen registry NCT06290141: VITALIZE; enrollment 160 (ESTIMATED); allocation RANDOMIZED; masking QUADRUPLE. Selected primary endpoint: Percentage of participants experiencing a response. Definition: A response is defined as decrease of ≥1 point from baseline in adjusted INCAT disability score at Week 24. Timeframe: Baseline to week 24. evidence_cards.title: Negative riliprubart prior in a different CIDP population
evidence_cards.text: Sanofi reports MOBILIZE in standard-care-refractory CIDP was stopped after interim futility assessment in June 2026; no new safety signal was identified. The July update says VITALIZE in IVIg-treated CIDP continues. Prior IVIg responsiveness, active comparator and residual-disability population differ. The futility result is relevant same-asset evidence but is not the VITALIZE outcome.

evidence_cards.title: Indirect open-label riliprubart CIDP week-24 evidence
evidence_cards.text: Sanofi reported an open-label, multicentre phase 2 CIDP study without a randomized comparator. At week 24, 42/48 SOC-treated patients (87%), 16/18 SOC-refractory patients (89%) and 11/12 SOC-naive patients (92%) improved or remained stable. Improvement alone occurred in 25/48 treated patients (52%) and 9/18 refractory patients (50%). These combined stable-or-improved proportions are not one shared primary response endpoint: Part A primary was relapse after SOC withdrawal for treated patients, and response during treatment for refractory/naive patients. Part B was an optional 52-week extension whose primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability. Two deaths occurred in patients with significant comorbidities; the release does not establish drug causality. SOC included immunoglobulins or corticosteroids. Nonrandomization, cohort differences, endpoint differences and selected extension participation prevent an estimate of superiority over maintenance IVIg in VITALIZE.

evidence_cards.title: Conditional open-label riliprubart CIDP week-76 evidence
evidence_cards.text: Sanofi's December 2025 presentation reports phase 2 CIDP extension outcomes at week 76 only among patient groups who achieved the week-24 primary endpoint. The conditional cohorts were SOC-treated n=40, SOC-refractory n=9 and SOC-naive n=7: 80% were relapse-free, 78% had sustained response and 86% had sustained response, respectively. Non-evaluable proportions were 13%, 11% and 14%; reported relapse proportions were 7% and 11% in the first two groups. These are open-label conditional extension outcomes, not percentages of the original 48/18/12 cohorts and not randomized treatment effects. They support potential durability in selected responders but cannot estimate VITALIZE week-24 adjusted-INCAT superiority against maintenance IVIg. Part B's primary endpoint was long-term safety/tolerability, as defined in the 2024 study description.

Selected primary endpoint: Number of participants with remission (Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score [BVAS] =0 and a dose of oral corticosteroid [OCS] less than or equal to [<=] 4 milligram [mg] per day). evidence_cards.title: Indirect placebo-controlled asthma evidence
evidence_cards.text: GSK reports SWIFT-1/2 severe-asthma trials each met their primary endpoint. The prespecified pooled analysis estimated exacerbation rate ratio 0.46 (95% CI 0.36-0.59) versus placebo. This differs in disease, endpoint and active comparator from OCEAN EGPA remission and cannot establish non-inferiority to mepolizumab.

evidence_cards.title: Sponsor confirms non-inferiority design
evidence_cards.text: The sponsor study register identifies OCEAN as a randomized double-dummy non-inferiority comparison of depemokimab and mepolizumab over 52 weeks. No non-inferiority margin or full operative SAP was established in this acquisition. Do not replace non-inferiority with superiority or infer a margin from another EGPA trial.

evidence_cards.title: Negative volrustomig phase III lung cancer prior
evidence_cards.text: AstraZeneca stopped eVOLVE-Lung02 after planned IDMC review concluded volrustomig + chemotherapy was unlikely to meet PFS or OS in PD-L1-negative metastatic NSCLC versus pembrolizumab + chemotherapy. No new safety signal was identified. Cervical, head-and-neck and mesothelioma trials continued. Tumour type, treatment setting, chemotherapy and comparator differ from cervical maintenance after chemoradiation.
